subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage accounting architecture as the sponsored core path for resolving forked-session token overcounting?
rationale: The implementation is technically credible, but its size, dual-accounting maintenance cost, persisted-cache behavior, and still-imperfect daily accuracy require product and architecture ownership rather than an automated merge judgment.

options.title: Sponsor the guarded stack
options.body: Review and merge all four exact heads in order while legacy remains the default and emergency rollback path.

options.title: Prefer the narrow repair first
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 for the immediate fork identity/cache defect and defer the larger lineage architecture.

options.title: Pause lineage adoption
options.body: Keep https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2037 open for investigation but do not add the dual-accounting architecture to core yet.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the guarded stack
recommendation.body: Review and merge all four exact heads in order while legacy remains the default and emergency rollback path.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and release integrator, steipete is the best available owner for the long-term accounting architecture decision.
